name: nrm
exec: (()=>{const out=[];window.__app.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&/^ground:(grass|granite|paving)$/.test(o.name)){const n=o.geometry.attributes.normal;let up=0,down=0,other=0;for(let i=0;i<n.count;i+=7){const y=n.getY(i);if(y>0.9)up++;else if(y<-0.9)down++;else other++;}out.push(o.name+' up='+up+' down='+down+' other='+other);}});return out.join(' | ')})()
